What this is / is not

Real: the tokens (measured from the reference image), the dark derivation, the contrast audit (14 pairs, all AA), the 48dp rule, layout, motion rules, and the copy tone.

Synthetic: every number and label — personas, sessions, topics, scores. No network calls, no storage, no analytics in this file.

Deliberately missing: a real Android permission hand-off (the primer simulates the system dialog and says so), encryption, ML, and any server. Those arrive in P0–P2.
